VBO:0200822.summary: Gentle yet reserved and independent, the Levriero Sardo has a strong urge to chase moving quarry. This Sardinian working sighthound has been used around rural flocks to pursue foxes. Its field heritage combines stamina with a lean, muscular build. Alongside that hunting drive, it is often calm with familiar people and lively in play.
VBO:0200822.shortDescription: A reserved, independent Sardinian sighthound with strong chase instincts, rural hunting roots and a lively interest in play.
